title: Spiced Yellow Lentil Curry
description: A flavorful and nutritious Indian-inspired curry made with yellow lentils, aromatic spices, and a hint of sweetness.
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the ginger, garlic, and red bell pepper, and cook for another 2 minutes.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the lentils, tomato, salt, and water, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
